newsitem.title: USA: Service says may need divestitures in deal.
newsitem.headline: Service says may need divestitures in deal.

text.p: Service Corp International, which is bidding $2.8 billion to acquire Loewen Group Inc, said on Friday that the competition issues raised by the proposed deal can be solved by selected divestitures without hurting the value of the deal.
Earlier today, Loewen Group said the Florida Attorney General is conducting an antitrust investigation of Service Corp's proposed takeover.
Loewen said it has received a civil subpoena for documents in connection with the probe.
In responding to Loewen's announcement about the subpoena, Service Corp, the largest owner of funeral homes and cemeteries, said it has no comment about whether it received one.
Loewen Group is Service Corp's next largest competitor and the second largest funeral home and cemetery operator in North America.
